bullets.content: For iperf/download interruption with post-disconnect no-reconnect pattern, start with connection_flow then disconnection_analysis; this two-skill sequence resolves missed-beacon cases efficiently.

When missed-beacon threshold crossing is confirmed in disconnection_analysis, stop investigation and report; two skills (connection_flow + disconnection_analysis) are sufficient — do not escalate further.
Always populate conclusion_tag explicitly (e.g., RF_INTERFERENCE) in the final report; never leave the classification implicit in recommendation text only.
